articles.title_en: All that glitters: A theory of multiple bubbles with implications for cryptocurrencies
articles.title_cn: 闪光的未必都是金子：多重泡沫理论及其对加密货币的启示
articles.abstract_en: We analyze a model of heterogeneous rational bubbles that compete and complement each other. When some bubbles burst, surviving ones gain value, offsetting losses from collapsed bubbles. This “compensation effect,” combined with diversification, enhances welfare. A portfolio of fragile bubbles may rival a single, stable bubble. The stationary equilibrium imposes a tight upper bound on bubble size, considering covariance structures, price fluctuations, and the emergence of new bubbles. These results have important policy implications, particularly for managing crypto ETFs and issuing CBDCs, highlighting the potential benefits of a diversified approach to fragile financial systems.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了一个异质性理性泡沫模型，这些泡沫既相互竞争又相互补充。当某些泡沫破裂时，存活的泡沫会增值，抵消崩溃泡沫带来的损失。这种“补偿效应”与多样化相结合，增进了福利。一个由脆弱泡沫组成的投资组合可能媲美一个单一、稳定的泡沫。稳态均衡对泡沫规模施加了严格的上限，考虑了协方差结构、价格波动以及新泡沫的出现。这些结果具有重要的政策含义，特别是在管理加密ETF和发行央行数字货币方面，凸显了对脆弱金融体系采取多元化方法的潜在益处。

articles.abstract_en: We link bond market functioning to future economic activity through a new measure, the Corporate Bond Market Distress Index (CMDI). The CMDI coalesces metrics from primary and secondary markets in real time, offering a unified measure to capture access to debt capital markets. The index correctly identifies periods of distress and predicts future realizations of commonly-used measures of market functioning, while the converse is not the case. We show that disruptions in access to corporate bond markets have an economically material, statistically significant impact on the real economy, even after controlling for standard predictors including credit spreads.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过一个新的衡量指标——公司债券市场困境指数（CMDI），将债券市场运作与未来经济活动联系起来。CMDI实时整合一级市场和二级市场的指标，提供一个统一的衡量标准来捕捉债务资本市场的准入情况。该指数正确识别了困境时期，并预测了常用市场运作指标的未来实现值，而反之则不成立。我们表明，即使在控制了包括信用利差在内的标准预测因子之后，公司债券市场准入的中断对实体经济具有经济上显著、统计上重要的影响。

articles.title_en: A plucking model of business cycles
articles.abstract_en: In standard models, economic activity fluctuates symmetrically around a “natural rate” and stabilization policies can dampen these fluctuations but do not affect the average level of activity. An alternative view – labeled the “plucking model” by Milton Friedman – is that economic fluctuations are drops below the economy’s full potential ceiling. We show that the dynamics of the unemployment rate in the US display a striking asymmetry that strongly favors the plucking model: increases in unemployment are followed by decreases of similar amplitude, while the amplitude of a decrease does not predict the amplitude of the following increase. In addition, business cycles last seven years on average and unemployment rises much faster during recessions than it falls during expansions. We augment a standard labor search model with downward nominal wage rigidity and show how it can fit the plucking property.
articles.abstract_cn: 在标准模型中，经济活动围绕“自然率”对称波动，稳定政策可以抑制这些波动，但不影响平均活动水平。另一种观点——被米尔顿·弗里德曼称为“摘取模型”——认为经济波动是低于经济充分潜力上限的下降。我们表明，美国失业率的动态表现出显著的不对称性，强烈支持摘取模型：失业率的上升之后伴随着相似幅度的下降，而下降的幅度并不能预测随后上升的幅度。此外，商业周期平均持续七年，且衰退期间失业率的上升速度远快于扩张期间的下降速度。我们在标准劳动力搜索模型中加入了向下名义工资刚性，并展示了它如何能够拟合摘取性质。

articles.title_en: Production and inventory dynamics under ambiguity aversion
articles.title_cn: 模糊厌恶下的生产与库存动态
articles.abstract_en: In this paper we propose a production-cost smoothing model with Knightian uncertainty and ambiguity aversion to study the joint behavior of production, inventories, and sales. Our model can explain ten facts that previous studies find difficult to account for simultaneously including the high volatility of production relative to sales, the low ratio of inventory-investment volatility to sales volatility, the positive correlation between sales and inventory investment, and the negative correlation between the inventory-to-sales ratio and sales. Our main results extend to a model of endogenous sales. Finally, we find that the stock-out avoidance motive emerges endogenously in our model, reconciling the long debate in the inventory literature over the production-cost smoothing and stock-out avoidance models.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们提出了一个带有奈特不确定性和模糊厌恶的生产成本平滑模型，以研究生产、库存和销售的联合行为。我们的模型能够解释先前研究难以同时解释的十个事实，包括生产相对于销售的高波动性、库存投资波动性与销售波动性的低比率、销售与库存投资之间的正相关关系，以及库存-销售比率与销售之间的负相关关系。我们的主要结果扩展到内生销售模型。最后，我们发现缺货规避动机在我们的模型中内生地出现，调和了库存文献中关于生产成本平滑与缺货规避模型的长期争论。

articles.title_en: An options-based impact study of the negative interest rate policy and forward guidance
articles.title_cn: 基于期权的负利率政策与前瞻指引影响研究
articles.abstract_en: The effect of Negative Interest Rate Policy (NIRP) and rate Forward Guidance (FG) on the yield curve is very similar with both policies exerting their maximal impact on a same spectrum of short-to-medium term maturities. Yet, we find that their impact on the predictive interest rate distribution differs. Accommodative FG prices out high interest rate trajectories, thus affecting upper percentiles; NIRP changes the market pricing of the effective lower bound on the policy rate, thus affecting lower percentiles. Building on this evidence, we combine option-implied rate densities with event-study analysis to separate the effects of NIRP and FG. We find that the impact of the ECB's NIRP on forward rates was stronger than that of FG.
articles.abstract_cn: 负利率政策（NIRP）和利率前瞻指引（FG）对收益率曲线的影响非常相似，两种政策都在短期至中期期限的同一区间内发挥最大影响。然而，我们发现它们对预测利率分布的影响有所不同。宽松的前瞻指引排除了高利率路径，从而影响上百分位数；负利率政策改变了市场对政策利率有效下限的定价，从而影响下百分位数。基于这一证据，我们将期权隐含利率密度与事件研究分析相结合，以分离负利率政策和前瞻指引的影响。我们发现，欧洲央行的负利率政策对远期利率的影响强于前瞻指引。

articles.title_en: The long-term effects of industrial policy
articles.abstract_en: This paper provides causal evidence on the impact of a large-scale industrial policy – South Korea’s Heavy and Chemical Industry (HCI) Drive – on firms’ long-term performance and quantifies its long-term welfare effects. Using unique historical data on the universe of firm-level subsidies and a natural experiment, we find large and persistent effects of this industrial policy. Subsidized firms grew faster than those never subsidized for 30 years after subsidies ended. We build a quantitative heterogeneous firm model that rationalizes these effects through a combination of learning-by-doing and financial frictions. The model is calibrated to firm-level data, and its key parameters are disciplined with the econometric estimates. The HCI Drive generated larger benefits than costs. If it had not been implemented, South Korea’s welfare would have been 3%–4% lower. The majority of the total welfare impact comes from the long-term productivity benefits of learning-by-doing.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了关于大规模产业政策——韩国重化工业（HCI）驱动——对企业长期绩效影响的因果证据，并量化了其长期福利效应。利用独特的历史数据，涵盖所有企业层面的补贴以及一项自然实验，我们发现该产业政策具有显著且持久的影响。受补贴企业在补贴结束后的30年内增长速度超过从未受补贴的企业。我们构建了一个定量异质性企业模型，通过边做边学与金融摩擦的结合来解释这些效应。模型以企业层面数据进行校准，其关键参数由计量经济学估计加以约束。HCI驱动带来的收益大于成本。如果未实施该政策，韩国的福利将降低3%至4%。总福利影响的大部分来自边做边学带来的长期生产率收益。

articles.title_en: Policy transition risk, carbon premiums, and asset prices
articles.title_cn: 政策转型风险、碳溢价与资产价格
articles.abstract_en: We analyze the effects of policy transition risk on asset pricing and the green transition using a global two-sector, macro-finance model of climate and the economy. Policy transition risk results from probabilistic changes between three policy states: no, modest, and ambitious carbon pricing. We show that policy transition risk leads to carbon premiums (i.e. higher expected returns on brown than on green assets), especially if the economy is still quite carbon-intensive and close to the temperature cap, and thus accelerate the green transition. Increased transition risk leads to more precautionary saving and falls in the risk-free rate. We offer extensions to deal with physical risks (temperature-related risk of climate disasters and climate tipping), technology transition risk, and more realistic policy tipping with endogenous transition probabilities.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用一个全球两部门、宏观金融气候与经济模型，分析了政策转型风险对资产定价和绿色转型的影响。政策转型风险源于三种政策状态之间的概率变化：无碳定价、适度碳定价和雄心勃勃的碳定价。我们表明，政策转型风险导致碳溢价（即棕色资产预期回报高于绿色资产），尤其是在经济仍相当碳密集且接近温度上限时，从而加速绿色转型。增加的转型风险导致更多的预防性储蓄和无风险利率下降。我们提供了扩展，以处理物理风险（气候灾害和气候临界点的温度相关风险）、技术转型风险，以及具有内生转型概率的更现实的政策临界点。

articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the role of wealth taxes in providing insurance against lifespan risk through the lens of a dynamic Mirrlees model with altruism. I derive novel formulas linking optimal taxes on savings and bequests to the degree of annuity market imperfections at the optimum. In the presence of positive correlation between productivity and life expectancy, optimal annuity markups are positive in expectation. This creates a motive not only for taxing savings but also for subsidizing bequests. When calibrating the model, I find that the forces of differential longevity lead to optimal wealth taxes commensurate with prevailing wealth tax rates in developed countries. Relative to the US status quo, optimal policies provide work incentives by increasing welfare of the short-lived at the bottom of the skill distribution. This channel generates significant welfare gains. Replacing the optimal annuity markup by a nonlinear history-independent approximation generates small efficiency losses.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过一个包含利他主义的动态米尔利斯模型，研究财富税在提供抵御寿命风险保险方面的作用。我推导出新的公式，将最优储蓄税和遗产税与最优状态下年金市场的不完美程度联系起来。在生产率与预期寿命正相关的情况下，最优年金加价在期望上是正的。这不仅产生了对储蓄征税的动机，也产生了补贴遗产的动机。在模型校准中，我发现寿命差异的力量导致的最优财富税与发达国家现行的财富税率相当。相对于美国的现状，最优政策通过提高技能分布底端短命者的福利来提供工作激励。这一渠道产生了显著的福利收益。用非线性的历史无关近似替代最优年金加价，仅产生较小的效率损失。

articles.title_en: Elasticity of substitution between robots and workers: Theory and evidence from Japanese robot price data
articles.title_cn: 机器人与工人之间的替代弹性：来自日本机器人价格数据的理论与证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the wage effects of the increased use of industrial robots, focusing on their role in specific tasks and international trade. I construct a novel dataset by tracking shocks to the cost of acquiring robots from Japan, termed the Japan Robot Shock (JRS), and analyze these shocks across different occupations that have adopted robots. A general equilibrium model incorporating robot automation in a large open economy is developed, and a model-implied optimal instrumental variable of the JRS is constructed to address the identification challenges posed by the correlation between automation shocks and the JRS. The study finds that the elasticity of substitution (EoS) between robots and labor is heterogeneous across occupations, reaching up to 3 in production and material moving occupations, which is significantly higher than the EoS between other capital goods and labor. These findings underscore the importance of targeted policy to help workers adapt and mitigate potential wage pressures.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了工业机器人使用增加对工资的影响，重点关注其在特定任务和国际贸易中的作用。我通过追踪日本机器人获取成本冲击构建了一个新颖的数据集，称为日本机器人冲击（JRS），并分析了这些冲击在不同采用机器人的职业中的影响。我开发了一个包含大型开放经济中机器人自动化的一般均衡模型，并构建了一个模型隐含的JRS最优工具变量，以应对自动化冲击与JRS之间相关性所带来的识别挑战。研究发现，机器人与劳动力之间的替代弹性（EoS）在不同职业间存在异质性，在生产及物料搬运职业中高达3，显著高于其他资本品与劳动力之间的替代弹性。这些发现强调了针对性政策的重要性，以帮助工人适应并缓解潜在的工资压力。

articles.abstract_en: Financial markets play an important role in generating monetary policy transmission asymmetries in the U.S. Credit spreads only adjust to unexpected increases in interest rates, causing output and prices to respond more to a monetary contraction than to a monetary loosening. At a one year horizon, the ‘financial multiplier’ of monetary policy — defined as the ratio between the cumulative responses of employment and credit spreads — is zero for a monetary loosening, -2 for a monetary contraction, and -4 for a monetary contraction that takes place under strained credit market conditions. These results have important policy implications: monetary policy may become inadvertently tight in times of financial distress.
articles.abstract_cn: 金融市场在美国货币政策传导不对称性中扮演重要角色。信贷利差仅对利率的意外上升进行调整，导致产出和价格对货币紧缩的反应大于对货币宽松的反应。在一年期水平上，货币政策的“金融乘数”——定义为就业和信贷利差的累积反应之比——在货币宽松时为零，在货币紧缩时为-2，在信贷市场紧张条件下发生的货币紧缩时为-4。这些结果具有重要的政策含义：在金融困境时期，货币政策可能无意中变得紧缩。

articles.abstract_en: The economics of helicopter money is fundamentally tied to price-level determination in monetary models. In frameworks with intrinsically worthless currencies, the issuer’s liabilities define the unit of account, and uniquely empower the issuer to implement helicopter money and escape liquidity traps. While traditional helicopter money requires cooperation between the treasury and the central bank — with the central bank critically guaranteeing treasury debt — we demonstrate that helicopter money can also be effectively executed independently by government or private currency issuers, without treasury involvement.
articles.abstract_cn: 直升机撒钱的经济学从根本上与货币模型中的价格水平决定相关。在具有内在无价值货币的框架中，发行者的负债定义了记账单位，并独特地赋予发行者实施直升机撒钱和摆脱流动性陷阱的能力。虽然传统的直升机撒钱要求财政部与中央银行之间的合作——其中中央银行关键地担保财政部债务——但我们证明，直升机撒钱也可以由政府或私人货币发行者独立有效执行，无需财政部参与。
